description: Calculate the employee retention rate exactly, by separating leavers who were on the payroll at the start of the period from leavers who were hired during it. Use it when you can tell those two groups of leavers apart; it returns the standard retention rate, the new-hire retention rate, the turnover rate and the ending headcount, and shows why retention and turnover do not add up to 100%. Use employee_turnover_rate instead when you only have one total for people who left.

leavers_from_new_hires.description: Leavers who were hired during the period. Cannot exceed new_hires.

leavers_from_starting_group.description: Leavers who were already on the payroll when the period opened. Cannot exceed starting_headcount.

starting_headcount.description: Employees on the payroll when the period opened.

name: employee_retention_rate

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.
